structural_change: COLLIO-F 10-23: fx geometry with ONE LANDING BAND PER CLOCK ROOT (RTL / cycles unchanged, L+2 as benched, witnesses results/rtl/cb16c_coll_1022/p_m*.log). All 10 fx gates failed CTS pin-flop spread (84-154 ps > 80): with the band fences dropped, GPL split each root into 2+ clusters 150-450 um apart (tx_wck wd on the N face vs its control in the spine; cal_ck txs vs W-face cdc_fault/rst flops; codec0 core in the col-B channels vs codec_data at SW). Now every source-owned sequential cell of a root is FIRM-landed in one band beside that root's macro clock/pin edge and entry (old body method, exact counts): W channel = rx | cal | lcal | tx (u_tx flipped MY->R0 so its clock/read/write-control edge faces the W channel like u_rx), spine = bank0 strip | codec | bank1-3 strips, E channel = phy (codec0p) + lcal PHY slots; rst_n/cdc_fault pins moved to the NW corner beside the tx_data pin registers (cal_ck boundary set compact), tx/cal entries NW, cal_lck W, codec entries at the spine foot. Outline unchanged 486.0 x 356.4.
